notes: Flat-roofed triple-decker, three even storeys, raised basement (row of small basement windows just above the ground on the south, red-painted foundation; not a storey). Window sills at about 6, 16 and 26 ft give floors at about 3.5, 13.3 and 23 ft; wall top about 34-35 ft. South: clear; a projecting bay at the left end (0-0.17) with a paired window on each storey, five single windows across the main wall, and a narrow window on the angled face of a right-end bay (~0.96). North: readable but dark and smeared on the lower left (storeys 1-2, 0.2-0.6, shadow), the window columns line up with storey 3; a pair of windows at 0.68/0.73 on each storey. East (street side?): mostly hidden by a tree; only storey 3 and the right part of storey 2 are readable, storey 1 left out; the entrance door is probably on this side but not seen. West: clear; a paired window and a single per storey, nothing on the left half; a slanted bulkhead / cellar hatch at ground level near 0.25, below the first floor, not recorded.
